name: Brainrot Charge🦄🦄
desc:
Join this exciting adventure!😎😎😎
In this game, you will control a unique vehicle pulled by Brainrot, smashing through obstacles, earning coins, and unlocking more fun items!

💡 How to play?
Click to accelerate and feel the thrill of speeding forward
Train your Brainrot to make it stronger
Use your cute pets to increase your power

💥 Can you break the limits and become the strongest driver?
